g.text: Each cell: row ~ s(column), the row variable on the vertical axis
A = asymmetry index |EDF_yx - EDF_xy| / (EDF_yx + EDF_xy), in [0, 1]
A is written above the upper cell of each pair; a dash when neither direction is significant
EDF = effective degrees of freedom of the smooth
Shape glyph = objective shape category (see shape-types legend below)
Cell border encodes non-linearity, EDF - 1 (see right-margin legend)
Cell background encodes Pearson r of the pair: white at 0, deeper towards -1 and 1

text.style: font-size: 13.00px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1A1A1A; font-family: sans;
